title: ‘Mesopotamia was never the cradle of civilisation, India was’: Historian on how ancient history was whitewashed
description: This historian said that once the Indus-Sarasvati cities were discovered they were found to be too sophisticated, too old and too large to fit comfortably into a Mesopotamia-first narrative, and hence the narrative was adjusted to accommodate them.
